story.body: You kept Nick on the whistle and yourself off the king. The third entrance was clean, and you stopped there. You said aloud that this afternoon's play does not include you. You went toward home.

story.body: You played Egeon to a quiet yard and said it was worse than a loud one. You heard the thin house counted by John and by Margery. Dick gave the wrapped leaves over. You let them go. You set seven shillings by, and you did not pay them. You did not call it a new balance.
